tools.name: browser_status
tools.description: Read selected profile status without switching the visible browser.

tools.name: browser_capabilities
tools.description: Discover actual API capabilities and limits before using the browser.

tools.name: browser_downloads
tools.description: Read local download progress metadata. Pending downloads use the shared prompt API; completed files have bounded chunk export.

tools.name: browser_diagnostics
tools.description: Inspect memory, battery policy, render frame age and API uptime.

tools.name: browser_background_recover
tools.description: Best-effort explicit restart of Abwr private background surface; throttled every 20 seconds.

tools.name: browser_privacy
tools.description: Inspect this profile's real storage isolation and global anti-fingerprinting scope.

tools.name: browser_fingerprint_protection
tools.description: Set Gecko native fingerprint protection for the shared browser runtime (all profiles, not individual identities).

tools.name: browser_get_url
tools.description: Read selected profile URL and title without changing the visible browser.

tools.name: browser_profiles
tools.description: List isolated account containers; browser profile != tab.

tools.name: profile_create
tools.description: Create a separate Gecko context without touching existing accounts.

tools.name: profile_switch
tools.description: Switch active visible container.

tools.name: profile_delete
tools.description: Delete specified container AND its website data; do not use on existing accounts without owner consent.

tools.name: browser_navigate
tools.description: Open an HTTP(S) URL; optionally wait for real page load completion.

tools.name: browser_back
tools.description: Navigate back for this profile.

tools.name: browser_forward
tools.description: Navigate forward for this profile.

tools.name: browser_reload
tools.description: Reload the current page for this profile.

tools.name: browser_snapshot
tools.description: Compact agent-readable accessibility-like DOM snapshot. Returns refs eN_N for subsequent target actions; ref is not a Playwright locator.

tools.name: browser_read
tools.description: Fast article-style page reading: main text, headings and metadata with bounded output.

tools.name: browser_dom
tools.description: Inspect page text and interactive DOM element metadata.

tools.name: browser_find
tools.description: Search page elements by CSS, visible text, role or aria-label.

tools.name: browser_links
tools.description: Get link text and URL list.

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Click a CSS selector or current-snapshot element ref; re-snapshot after navigation.

tools.name: browser_type
tools.description: Fill an input, textarea or plain contenteditable editor; set submit=true to submit its form.

tools.name: browser_clear
tools.description: Clear an input, textarea or plain contenteditable editor.

tools.name: browser_toggle
tools.description: Set checkbox or radio element checked state.

tools.name: browser_select
tools.description: Select dropdown option by value.

tools.name: browser_focus
tools.description: Focus an input or focusable element.

tools.name: browser_press
tools.description: Send native Gecko keyboard input, including Enter, Tab, Backspace, Delete, arrows and Ctrl+A. Focus a target first or supply target/selector.

tools.name: browser_click_point
tools.description: Send a native touch in current browser viewport pixels. For JPEG coordinates supply imageWidth/imageHeight from screenshot metadata. Inspect after input to confirm the site's response.

tools.name: browser_drag
tools.description: Send a native drag in the active browser viewport. The gesture cancels if the document, surface or manual takeover changes. Coordinates are viewport pixels.

tools.name: browser_private_profile
tools.description: Open a new private browsing container. Private tabs and history are not persisted; downloaded files remain.

tools.name: browser_reopen_tab
tools.description: Reopen the most recently closed ordinary tab in the specified container.

tools.name: browser_frames
tools.description: List connected frame documents. Use the frame ID for iframe actions; snapshot/read include child-frame results by default.

tools.name: browser_scroll
tools.description: Scroll vertically with y, or legacy direction (up/down) and pixels. Do not mix both formats.

tools.name: browser_scroll_to
tools.description: Scroll to top/bottom or bring a target into view.

tools.name: browser_wait
tools.description: Wait in the Android event pump for selector/text, URL/document changes, load, frame readiness, observed network idle or an explicit delay.

tools.name: browser_bookmarks
tools.description: List saved URL bookmarks in Abwr profile.

tools.name: browser_bookmark_add
tools.description: Save a site URL as a bookmark in selected profile.

tools.name: browser_history
tools.description: Read browser URL history for one Abwr profile.

tools.name: browser_find_in_page
tools.description: Native GeckoView highlight and locate text on currently selected page.

tools.name: browser_clear_find
tools.description: Remove GeckoView find-in-page highlights.

tools.name: browser_settings
tools.description: Read active browser search engine, desktop mode and tracking protection.

tools.name: browser_desktop_mode
tools.description: Toggle desktop website UA and viewport for an Abwr container.

tools.name: browser_search_engine
tools.description: Set UI default search engine: google, duckduckgo, brave or bing.

tools.name: browser_tabs
tools.description: List tabs and active popup in current container.

tools.name: browser_tab_groups
tools.description: List saved groups inside a container; groups preserve existing tab sessions.

tools.name: browser_group_create
tools.description: Create a named group with color 0..5 and optional existing tab IDs; preserves login storage.

tools.name: browser_group_update
tools.description: Rename or recolor a group inside the specified container.

tools.name: browser_group_move
tools.description: Move existing tabs to this group. Omit id to remove the tabs from their groups.

tools.name: browser_group_ungroup
tools.description: Dissolve the group while keeping all its tabs and website sessions.

tools.name: browser_tab_new
tools.description: Open a new tab inside an Abwr container, retaining the same account storage.

tools.name: browser_tab_select
tools.description: Switch to a tab by id. Use browser_tabs to discover valid ids.

tools.name: browser_tab_close
tools.description: Close a tab by id without deleting its whole account container.

tools.name: browser_compatibility
tools.description: Read page-only login/challenge compatibility signals. Does not solve or bypass CAPTCHA, OAuth or anti-bot checks.

tools.name: browser_devtools
tools.description: Read opt-in Console and HTTP metadata/body previews plus DOM diagnostics. record and captureBodies enable recording; clear removes data. Not CDP.

tools.name: browser_storage_inspect
tools.description: Inspect current-origin Web Storage with token-like values redacted.

tools.name: browser_cookie_names
tools.description: Read document-visible Cookie names only, excluding HttpOnly values.

tools.name: browser_http_request
tools.description: Send bounded HTTP(S) requests. auto uses page Fetch with profile cookies on the currently loaded origin; otherwise native anonymous HTTP. stream=true returns an ID for real incremental base64 chunks; poll or use eventsPath. Never automatically retries a request.

tools.name: browser_http_poll
tools.description: Read live HTTP stream events after an absolute sequence cursor. Chunk data is base64 upstream bytes, not simulated tokens. Streams expire after completion.

tools.name: browser_http_cancel
tools.description: Cancel an outstanding HTTP stream.

tools.name: browser_extensions
tools.description: List installed signed extensions and states.

tools.name: browser_userscripts
tools.description: List built-in userscripts and runtime status without script source.

tools.name: browser_inspect_element
tools.description: Inspect CSS properties, attributes, bounds and children for a CSS selector; input values and data attributes are redacted.

tools.name: browser_popup_close
tools.description: Close the popup in specified container.

tools.name: browser_takeover
tools.description: Hand same container to human (manual=true) or back to AI (false).

tools.name: browser_screenshot
tools.description: Capture real current JPEG pixels; requires a valid GeckoView display surface.

tools.name: browser_screenshot_meta
tools.description: Read screenshot age and whether cache is stale.

tools.name: browser_screenshot_last
tools.description: Retrieve OLD cached JPEG, NEVER current live pixels.

tools.name: browser_proxy_info
tools.description: Read the configured profile route without credentials. Configuration is not connectivity proof.

tools.name: browser_proxy_set
tools.description: Configure a profile HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS5 proxy using separate credential fields; unsupported runtimes refuse it.

tools.name: browser_pointer_path
tools.description: Replay a bounded timed native touch path. Pre-down moves position the touch, without mouse hover.

tools.name: browser_key_sequence
tools.description: Send native keys with a fixed interval; never replay a partially dispatched sequence.

tools.name: browser_geometry
tools.description: Read bounding box, visibility, computed role and center in frame CSS viewport coordinates.

tools.name: browser_readonly_probe
tools.description: Explicitly enabled allowlisted geometry/viewport queries, with audit metadata. No JS source accepted.

tools.name: browser_network_observe
tools.description: Opt-in bounded network events for a tab, including status, redacted headers and redirect events. afterSeq acknowledges consumed events.

tools.name: browser_prompts
tools.description: List pending site dialogs. API and UI may answer the same scoped prompt once.

tools.name: browser_prompt_resolve
tools.description: Explicitly answer the named scoped site prompt; inspect the resulting page afterwards.

tools.name: browser_file_import
tools.description: Import at most 64 KiB of test-file bytes as an Android content URI readable by Abwr.

tools.name: browser_download_action
tools.description: Cancel/remove a named download or export a bounded file chunk from its owning profile.

tools.name: browser_storage_export
tools.description: Explicitly consented, scoped storage debug export. Credentials remain redacted.

tools.name: browser_audit
tools.description: Read bounded metadata audit history without credentials.

tools.name: browser_queues
tools.description: Inspect bounded page/control queues and in-flight profiles.
